top_signals.title: India’s Rupee Gains as RBI Takes More Steps to Support Currency
top_signals.summary: India’s rupee extended its gains on Tuesday as the central bank announced more measures to support the currency which faces constant pressure from high oil prices and foreign outflows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Chip stocks slide in wake of ‘casino’ comment by Broadcom boss
top_signals.summary: Declines for Samsung and SK Hynix drag Kospi sharply lower as investors fret over scale of AI investment
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: CMORG holds sector-wide cloud outage simulation exercise
top_signals.summary: The Cross-Market Operational Resilience Group (CMORG) yesterday (8 October 2026) completed its biennial simulation exercise, known as SIMEX26, focused this year on a global cloud services disruption.

top_signals.title: Guidance: Preston guidance: September 2026
top_signals.summary: Preston factors (earnings and interest factors) are provided for employers.

top_signals.title: Producer price growth cools, easing urgency for further Bank of Japan hikes
top_signals.summary: The measure of input prices climbed 6.8% in September from a year earlier, slowing from 7.6% in the previous month, according to the Bank of Japan.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
